determinism_rules: JSON is written with sorted keys and a fixed indent
no wall-clock timestamp enters any scientific content
no filesystem iteration order affects output; every collection is sorted by an explicit key
a second build from unchanged inputs produces identical bytes

read_only_trees.results/closure: the approved statistical and efficiency closure. Read only. VE-0, VE-1 and VE-2 consume it and never rewrite it.
read_only_trees.results/experiments/e10_capacity_360m_co: E10 is CLOSED. Read only. No VE-1 or VE-2 process may write here, re-run a cell, or modify any file inside experiments/e10_capacity_360m.
read_only_trees.tests/run_all.py: inside E10's frozen SOURCE_PATHS. Editing it moves the sealed live source digest and breaks all three E10 phase verifiers. VE-0 ships its own runner, tests/run_ve0.py, for the same reason the closure shipped tests/run_closure.py.
read_only_trees.the embargoed clean-test targets under d: EMBARGOED. Never opened, never resolved, never hashed. VE-0 code names the file only inside the refusal guard, and every VE-0 writer refuses a payload containing that token, so no VE-0, VE-1 or VE-2 artefact can carry it even by accident.

required_fields.note: stable identifier, for example VE0-FIG-02 or VE2-QUAL-QC03-01
hash of the builder source at build time
every evidence_id consumed, resolved and explicit
the exact command that reproduces the artefact
any seed or salt that affects content; for qualitative selection this is the frozen VE-0 salt
hash of the scientific content with the provenance block removed. This is the value a later rebuild must reproduce
OPTIONAL metadata. It must not enter content_sha256, and VE-0 writes no timestamp into any artefact at all, so a VE-0 rebuild is byte-identical, not merely content-identical

rule: every VE-1 and VE-2 artefact must be reproducible from VE-0 alone, given the repository at the recorded HEAD.
title: provenance contract
traceability_statement: a figure in the dissertation, a table in the dissertation and a slide in the supervisor deck must each resolve, through this contract, to the same evidence_id and hence to the same frozen artefact bytes.
